built_from: git archive of CatholicGPT at the version commit (clean tree)
changes: Liturgical notices (Explore > Reminders): season start and weekly proposal, eve and day of solemnities and feasts, Sunday Mass, novena and plan days, evening Rosary, night examen and a gentle monthly invitation to Confession; all off by default, each with its own time; holy days of obligation only for the days the user selects (T-032, texts T-035).
Two home-screen widgets: Liturgical day (celebration, season, colour and Gospel) and My path (today's habits, novena and plan in progress) (T-032).
Personalized welcome: the chosen profile and time order a 'For you today' block on Today; 'Your path' in Settings changes them; included in backup (T-037, texts T-033).
Complete Catechism index bundled for a future navigable index (T-036); not yet shown.
tests: Full unit suite: 761 tests, 1 known failure (ExampleRobolectricTest app_name under the preview init script)
known_limitations: Not tested on a physical phone.
Alarm timing with exact alarms denied, OEM battery restrictions, Doze and real launcher rendering of the widgets could not be verified in Robolectric.
